# SD Gas

> Gas Safe registered gas engineer and plumber covering Fife, Scotland. Boiler installation, servicing, and repair, plumbing, heat pump servicing, and Legionella risk assessments, available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

SD Gas is a small, independent heating and plumbing business based on Bennochy Road, Kirkcaldy, Fife (KY2 5). Gas Safe registration number 665290.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://sd-gas.co.uk/home): Overview of services, service area, and customer reviews.
- [Services](https://sd-gas.co.uk/service): Full detail on boiler servicing, installation, repair, plumbing, heat pump servicing, and Legionella risk assessments.
- [Certificates & Accreditation](https://sd-gas.co.uk/certificates): Gas Safe registration, insurance, and written work records.
- [Request a Call](https://sd-gas.co.uk/schedule): Contact form to book an engineer callback.
- [Privacy Policy](https://sd-gas.co.uk/privacy): How enquiry data submitted through the site is handled.
